# GET /api/v1/users/{username}/activities/feeds

List a user's activity feeds with optional date and performer filters

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** none (optional, affects private feed visibility) · **ID:** `ep-127`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| username | path | string | True |
| only-performed-by | query | boolean | False |
| date | query | string (YYYY-MM-DD) | False |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| Severity | Type | Description | Recommendation |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| high | n_plus_1_queries | ToActivities calls GetDoerRepoPermission for each action's repo individually | Batch permission checks or cache repo permissions per request |
| medium | no_caching | Activity feeds are queried from DB on every request with no caching layer | Consider short-lived cache for feed results (1-5 min TTL) |

### Optimization Recommendations

- **[P1] query_optimization**: Batch repo permission checks in ToActivities instead of per-action — *Impact: Reduce N permission queries to 1 batch query for unique repos*
- **[P2] caching**: Cache activity feed results with short TTL — *Impact: Reduce DB load for frequently accessed user profiles*
